items.title: Brazil proposes mandatory take-back scheme for solar panels, batteries
items.summary: A bill under review in Brazil's Chamber of Deputies stipulates that manufacturers, importers and retailers should be responsible for collecting and recycling equipment after its end-of-life. The post Brazil proposes mandatory take-back scheme for solar panels, batteries appeared first on pv magazine Global .

items.title: India targets 5 GW of floating PV with co-located storage
items.summary: A newly-approved government scheme in India plans to support the development of 5 GW of floating solar on existing reservoirs and industrial ponds, to be paired with energy storage systems with a minimum storage capacity of two hours. The post India targets 5 GW of floating PV with co-located storage appeared first…

items.title: Fluence books first big data centre deals, but manufacturing ramp-up delays hit revenues
items.summary: Manufacturing delays have led Fluence to adjust its fiscal year 2026 guidance, even as the company has logged record quarterly orders and a US$6.4 billion backlog.

items.title: US data centers turn to on-site solar, storage, VPPs as grid delays mount
items.summary: A Reuters Events report highlights how multi-year transmission delays are forcing data center developers in the United States to deploy 56 GW of on-site generation while turning to Virtual Power Plants to unlock fast capacity. items.summary: Also, Public Service Enterprise Group is “encouraged” by potential changes to the utility business model in New Jersey, CEO Ralph LaRossa said.

items.title: Facing an estimated 474 GW of interconnection requests, Texas hits pause on data centers
items.summary: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott has called for an audit of all data centers in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas interconnection queue, leading the grid operator to delay its Batch Zero review process.

items.title: Bangladesh hits 1 GW rooftop solar capacity
items.summary: The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis finds Bangladesh's rooftop solar capacity exceeds official figures, as it makes recommendations for more supportive policy to capitalize on untapped rooftop potential. The post Bangladesh hits 1 GW rooftop solar capacity appeared first on pv magazine Global .

items.title: Thailand registers solar installers, equipment ahead of rooftop PV expansion
items.summary: Thailand is formally registering qualified solar installers and equipment ahead of launching a government-backed program that will aim to deploy rooftop solar on 500,000 households. items.title: Base Power raises another US$1 billion in Series D financing for US residential BESS
items.summary: Residential energy storage startup Base Power has announced a US$1 billion Series D financing at a US$13 billion post-money valuation, and the launch of its new home battery in production in Austin, Texas, US.

items.title: Fraunhofer ISE, Source Energy develop silicon PV modules for space satellites
items.summary: The new technology is considered a more economical alternative to the solar cells based on group III-V semiconductors that are currently used in space applications. The post Fraunhofer ISE, Source Energy develop silicon PV modules for space satellites appeared first on pv magazine Global .

items.title: Sudan exempts solar systems from custom duties
items.summary: The decision follows a fire at the country’s largest hydroelectric plant which caused power outages across four Sudanese states. The post Sudan exempts solar systems from custom duties appeared first on pv magazine Global .

items.title: KKR’s ContourGlobal begins construction of ‘Sun at Night’ solar-plus-storage project in Chile
items.summary: Independent power producer (IPP) ContourGlobal has begun construction of its fourth large-scale solar PV and battery storage hybrid project in Chile.

items.title: Invinity sells 43MWh long-duration flow battery system to US Midwest rural electric cooperative
items.summary: Flow battery company Invinity Energy Systems has sold 43MWh of battery systems to utility Dairyland Power Cooperative for deployment across long duration energy storage (LDES) projects in the US Midwest.

items.title: Japan: Tokyo Gas enters offtake for 200MWh Fukushima BESS, Eku Energy nears completion of first project
items.summary: Japanese utility Tokyo Gas has entered into a long-term offtake agreement for a 49.7MW/202.1MWh battery storage project in Fukushima Prefecture.

items.title: Largest BESS in Czech Republic commissioned, supplied by CATL-backed CNTE
items.summary: The largest grid-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) project in the Czech Republic has gone online, supplied by a company invested in by lithium-ion OEM CATL.

items.title: Eversource Q2 income plunges on transmission ROE, offshore wind charges
items.summary: Jefferies analysts cast doubt on Connecticut Light and Power’s $1 billion advanced metering infrastructure proposal, which has a negative benefit-to-cost ratio.

items.title: Southern Co. contracted large load rises to 17 GW
items.summary: Recently announced projects include a 3.2-GW OpenAI data center near Savannah, Georgia. The contract includes 1 GW of “flexible demand response” for peak shaving — the first such flexibility provision the company has codified with a data center customer.

items.title: Massachusetts issues RFP seeking 1,000MW of BESS
items.summary: Massachusetts’s Department of Energy Resources (DOER) has issued a request for proposals (RFP) for 1,000MW of energy storage in the US state.

items.title: Prosalia and EDP hybridise solar PV/wind projects with batteries in Portugal, Spain
items.summary: IPP Prosalia has commissioned a 15MW/60MWh battery storage system at a solar PV plant in Portugal, while power group EDP has added one to a hybrid wind and solar project in Spain.

items.title: European multi-day energy storage startup Ore Energy raises US$43 million in Series A
items.summary: Iron-air battery company Ore Energy has raised US$43 million in a Series A funding round to commercialise its multi-day energy storage technology.

items.title: Load smoothing, cold-start backup and speed-to-power: Fluence maps the battery storage opportunity for Australian data centres
items.summary: ESN Premium speaks with Fluence's Jeff Monday and Sam Markham on the opportunity battery energy storage could provide data centres in Australia.

items.title: Habitat Energy appointed to optimise DC-coupled 614MWh solar-plus-storage portfolio for Octopus Australia
items.summary: Habitat Energy has been appointed by Octopus Australia to provide optimisation services for two DC-coupled solar-plus-storage sites.

items.title: Dominion offshore wind project cost rises nearly $300M
items.summary: The increase is due to revised network upgrade costs assigned by the PJM Interconnection, tariffs imposed by the Trump administration in April and updated turbine installation projections, executives said.

items.title: ‘You cannot build a whole electricity system purely on solar hybrids’: Squadron Energy CEO warns
items.summary: BESS and solar have driven Australia past the halfway mark in NEM renewable penetration, but the technology mix is not yet broad enough.

items.title: Grid-forming BESS not yet confirmed for minimum system strength in Australia as AEMO launches fault current trial
items.summary: Grid-forming BESS have not yet been confirmed to meet the highest tier of system strength requirements in Australia's NEM, according to AEMO.

items.title: Antora Energy closes US$550 million Series C to scale US thermal battery deployment
items.summary: Thermal energy storage (TES) technology provider Antora Energy has closed a US$550 million Series C funding round to accelerate deployment of its thermal battery storage systems for industrial facilities and data centres in the US.

items.title: Veolia to operate 350MW microgrid for AI data centre in central Ohio
items.summary: Environmental services company Veolia has been selected to operate and maintain a 350MW microgrid to power an AI data centre campus in New Albany, Ohio, US, which includes a 430MWh BESS.

items.title: ‘Business as usual, just accelerated’: Harmony Energy CEO on life after Alpiq acquisition
items.summary: We caught up with Peter Kavanagh, CEO of BESS developer Harmony Energy, after it was acquired by Switzerland-headquartered power group Alpiq.

items.title: Greenvolt inaugurates 200MW/800MWh capacity market-contracted BESS in Poland
items.summary: Greenvolt Power has inaugurated the 200MW Turośń Kościelna Battery Energy Storage Facility in Poland, which energy trader Entrix will optimise.

items.title: Thermal energy storage company 1414 Degrees secures 1GW data centre deal in South Australia
items.summary: 1414 Degrees has signed a deal to develop up to 1GW of AI data centre infrastructure at its Aurora Energy Precinct in South Australia.

items.title: Aecon executes energy storage agreement for 1,200MWh Ontario BESS
items.summary: Infrastructure and construction company Aecon Group has executed an agreement with Ontario’s Independent Electricity System Operator (IESO) for the 150MW/1,200MWh Simcoe energy storage project in Norfolk County, Ontario.

items.summary: IPP Eolian has begun construction on Flint Grid, a 200MW/1.06GWh energy storage project in Jersey Township, Licking County, Ohio, US.
